definitions.gloss: military expansion; arms buildup; military buildup
definitions.explanation: The expansion or strengthening of a country's military forces, including increases in personnel, weapons, and defense spending. An abbreviation of 軍備拡張.

examples.japanese: {軍拡|ぐんかく}⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{周辺国|しゅうへんこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軍拡|ぐんかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{懸念|けねん}→懸念：05622_kenen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: They expressed concern about the military buildup of neighboring countries.

examples.japanese: {軍拡|ぐんかく}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{軍縮|ぐんしゅく}→軍縮：24085_gunshuku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Domestic opinion is divided over whether to expand or reduce the military.

notes:
An abbreviation of ⟦{軍備|ぐんび}→軍備：22011_gunbi⟧⟦{拡張|かくちょう}→拡張：12812_kakuchou⟧ (military expansion). Frequently used in news and political discourse about defense policy and international security.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍拡|ぐんかく}⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: arms race
- {軍拡|ぐんかく}⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧: expansionist military policy
- {軍拡|ぐんかく}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: military expansion budget

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軍縮|ぐんしゅく}→軍縮：24085_gunshuku⟧: disarmament, military reduction — the opposite; abbreviation of ⟦{軍備|ぐんび}→軍備：22011_gunbi⟧⟦{縮小|しゅくしょう}→縮小：02568_shukushou⟧
- ⟦{軍備|ぐんび}→軍備：22011_gunbi⟧: armament, military preparedness — the broader concept of military equipment and readiness
- {再軍備|さいぐんび}: rearmament — rebuilding military forces after disarmament
